{{# Avoca's copy of the Peak Tools form handler (statamic-peak-tools::snippets/_form_handler, copied from Peak Tools v9.2.1). Laravel uses this file instead of the package's because it sits in resources/views/vendor/statamic-peak-tools. What changed and why: only the error summary lookup in submit(). Peak Tools searches the whole page for #summary, so on a page with two forms, focus after a failed submit could land in the other form's summary. This copy searches inside its own form (this.$refs.form) for the summary, whose ID carries the form handle and ends in -form-summary (see page_builder/_form.antlers.html). If Peak Tools changes its form handler, copy the new version over this file and make the same change again. #}} {{# @name Form handler @desc Alpine based form handler used in `resources/views/page_builder/_form.antlers.html`. #}} {{ once }} {{# The Statamic helpers for conditional fields. #}} {{ /once }}
